# generated by scripts/pai_report.py (decompose); per-scene composition of the PAI score

Score = 0 when any of at-fault collision / offroad / corridor is set, else `progress_score` = min(clamp(progress_clipped_rel, 0, 1) / 0.8, 1). Raw flag counts overlap; `exc` = zero with no flag (driver exception). `prog all` includes failed rollouts (progress is recorded for them); `prog nz` = non-zero scenes only.

## Arm minus base, paired by seed index and scene: where the mean difference comes from

Per seed pair the mean difference (arm - base, over 60 scenes) = (gain + loss + change) / 60 with gain = sum of arm scores on scenes zero in base and non-zero in arm; loss = minus the sum of base scores on scenes non-zero in base and zero in arm; change = sum of score differences on scenes non-zero in both. Counts and contributions are averages over the seed pairs of the family.
